highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Health Sciences University (HSU) is a specialist university in the United Kingdom with campuses in Bournemouth and Central London. It focuses on delivering healthcare education, research, and clinical practice. Plus, HSU is recognised for its expertise in health and rehabilitation sciences.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: HSU offers you a range of student support services, including academic support, mental health and wellbeing guidance, helping you right from day one. Plus, you can meet students from various backgrounds.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
If you’re studying in Bournemouth, you can opt for on-campus or university-recommended options like Lulworth Student Accommodation, which offers a safe and comfortable student environment. You’ll have access to shared kitchens, social spaces, study areas, and leisure facilities.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
On campus, you’ll have well-equipped learning and library facilities with books, journals, anatomical models, collaborative spaces, and study areas.

Sports
HSU offers modern sports facilities, including a refurbished student gym, alongside various student sports clubs (football, rugby, etc.).

Laboratory
You’ll find dedicated clinical performance labs for sport science (biomechanics, physio). Plus, HSU partners with professional clubs like AFC Bournemouth, providing you access to high-level testing and training environments.

Cafeteria
You’ll find a range of food options at the newly refurbished Campus Cafe.
